author: _DISTRACTION_
body:
Borone is a Skywars map with two versions: Borone CTF and Borone KoTH. They are standard Skywars-CTF and Skywars-KoTH maps, with the same rule-sets as the others.



The maps have been added to the Skywars rotation on Github, but I believe {tag=c2a4c847653e482ab62ed7f8b64330cb} needs to push the rotation to the server before the maps will appear there.

Photo Album: http://imgur.com/a/vaC7E
